You will play a critical role as our systems scale to handle a jump from 1.2 million to over 2.4 million produced boxes per week due to recent software product consolidation. You will look after speeding up development, decision-making, and problem-solving. You will work with our neighboring teams to ensure that our efforts aim to achieve a clearer architecture and boundaries between tech teams to support autonomy. You will communicate directly with our business stakeholders and multiple tech teams supporting local markets. You will report to the Director of Engineering in the Production tribe. This role does not include people management responsibilities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What you\u2019ll do: The Recipe&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assume technical leadership within a tribe and own the most challenging tech decisions, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operational excellence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the teams in the architectural design and help to maintain architectural integrity in the scope of the tribe and beyond.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Spend a significant portion of your time orchestrating code generation\u2014guiding AI coding agents, rigorously reviewing their implementations, and refining logic based on organization needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solve software problems that have visible risks, roadblocks, and constraints. You will navigate an environment that is approximately &lt;strong&gt;70% greenfield development and 30% legacy systems&lt;\/strong&gt;, managing dependencies, data quality, compliance, and architectural transformations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentor more junior engineers by fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What you\u2019ll bring: The Ingredients&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ideally, 10+ years of engineering experience, including 2+ years in a staff\/principal level capacity and technical leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong capability in working with different stakeholders and experience addressing physical world problems with software solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Full-Stack &amp;amp; Agentic Engineering: Deep problem-solving skills and full-stack proficiency (e.g., C#, Python, Golang, and modern frontend technologies). We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority \u2014 automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.<br><br>Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.<br><br>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products \u2013 Hydris \u2013 the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it.\u00a0<br><br>You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving.\u00a0<br><br>The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.<br><br>What you'll do<br>Core engine development<ul><li>Design and build the systems that power Hydris.<\/li><li>Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.<\/li><li>Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale \u2014 often all of that simultaneously.<\/li><\/ul>Protocol and integration architecture<ul><li>Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.<\/li><li>Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.<\/li><li>Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.<\/li><li>Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.<\/li><li>Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins\/integrations to Hydris.<\/li><\/ul>Distributed systems<ul><li>Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.<\/li><li>Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.<\/li><li>Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.<\/li><\/ul>Technical leadership<ul><li>Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.<\/li><li>Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.<\/li><li>Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.<\/li><\/ul><br>You should apply if you<ul><li>Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.<\/li><li>Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.<\/li><li>Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.<\/li><li>Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical At HRT, you&#39;ll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are always seeking highly motivated and skilled Software Engineers across many different teams at HRT. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you&#39;ll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking highly motivated and skilled &lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);&quot;&gt;Research Engineers&lt;\/span&gt; who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world&#39;s most sophisticated trading strategies.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers\u2019 research iteration.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT\u2019s live trading.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improving HRT\u2019s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) \u2013 you\u2019ll interact with markets across the world!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT\u2019s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don\u2019t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Qualifications&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Completed a Bachelor&#39;s or Master&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor&#39;s degree, please apply to our Campus\/New Grad opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Previous experience at a top-tier finance &lt;em&gt;or&lt;\/em&gt; technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have &lt;em&gt;real&lt;\/em&gt; hands-on experience with quant research and\/or ML\/Deep Learning platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No \u201csmart jerks\u201d at HRT.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;If you have management experience, that\u2019s always a bonus \u2013 but even so, expect to code!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). All of our Fullstack Developers have internal customers and deeply understand end-user needs. They build backend processes to ingest and transform vast quantities of data, and UIs to visualize and action that data quickly.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work on our in-house distributed-compute framework designed for execution on a large scale within HRT\u2019s compute cluster. This framework serves various teams, with our algo teams being the primary users, particularly for training complex models.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with our Algo Developers and traders, building backend processes and UIs for them to oversee trading processes, execute manual trades, assess risk, and research improvements to our strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with a variety of senior technical and non-technical users and own projects end-to-end, from inception to gathering and refining requirements, forming and executing a structured plan, and managing ongoing support and iterations to the initial plan.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Architect web-based tooling to provide insights and enable real-time actions using financial data, operational data, trading activity, and more using React and Python.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The interview process will evaluate your backend programming skills (primarily Python), and your experience working in JavaScript\/TypeScript on a modern web framework (React skills are required!). It is important that you are excited about and comfortable with working on both sides of the stack. All fullstack candidates will go through the same assessment &amp;amp; two technical phone interviews. We will start team alignment discussions if (when!) you get to onsite. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Being a Dialer&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;At Dialpad, AI isn\u2019t just a feature; it\u2019s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee\u2019s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;We believe every conversation matters. And we\u2019ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits:&lt;strong&gt; Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Your role&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;The primary purpose of our AI Transformation Architect team is to accelerate the adoption and realization of value from our AI platform by embedding within our most strategic customer accounts. You will be the crucial link that translates complex business challenges into validated, high-impact Agentic AI solution designs, driving business outcomes. AI Transformation Architects will act as the company&#39;s most technically fluent business consultant and the customer&#39;s most trusted AI architects throughout the presales motion.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;What you&#39;ll do&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Business Translation and Discovery: Rapidly embed with customer stakeholders and operational leaders to deeply understand their most complex, high-stakes business problems. Translate ambiguous business objectives into clear, Agentic AI solutions.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;The Go-To-Market Bridge: Partner directly with our Sales, Sales Engineers, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams to serve as the deep technical authority during critical pre-sales evaluations. You don&#39;t just sell the vision; you create technical validation through strategic AI workshops and Proofs of Concept.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Product Alignment and Influence: Capture common customer pain points, successful integration patterns, and platform limitations discovered in the field. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a Data Analyst III to join our Sportsbook organization in the Product Analytics team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role will focus on creating insights to drive product development and enhance business performance. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Firmus AI Cloud&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why Firmus?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there&#39;s minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;Considering applying? You don&#39;t need a perfect background to join our team. If you&#39;re driven and curious, there&#39;s a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role Summary&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Procurement &amp;amp; Supply Chain Compliance Specialist is responsible for ensuring the organisation&#39;s procurement and supply chain activities are conducted in accordance with legal, regulatory, contractual, ethical and corporate governance requirements. Working within a highly regulated technology environment, the role provides oversight of supplier governance, third-party assurance, procurement compliance, ESG obligations, modern slavery requirements, information security due diligence, operational resilience and supplier assurance activities. The role partners with Procurement, Legal, Risk, Information Security and business stakeholders to ensure suppliers are selected, managed and monitored in a manner that supports organisational objectives while protecting the organisation from operational, financial, reputational and regulatory risk.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The position plays a key role in strengthening supplier governance frameworks, improving supply chain transparency and ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory obligations and customer expectations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;p1&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Procurement Governance &amp;amp; Compliance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of procurement governance frameworks, policies and procedures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor compliance with procurement policies, delegated authorities and sourcing requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Review procurement activities to ensure adherence to internal controls and governance obligations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support procurement assurance reviews and compliance reporting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide guidance to business units on procurement governance and compliance requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Supplier Risk Management and Compliance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coordinate supplier due diligence, risk assessment and compliance activities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assess suppliers against financial, operational, cyber security, privacy, regulatory and reputational risk criteria.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain supplier risk registers and supplier assurance records.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor supplier performance and compliance throughout the contract lifecycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Escalate material supplier risks and compliance issues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure contractual obligations relating to compliance, security and privacy are appropriately managed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain supplier governance documentation and records.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support contract governance and performance management activities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain evidence supporting compliance with procurement and contractual requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assist in resolving supplier compliance issues and non-conformances.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Operational Resilience &amp;amp; We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure \u2013 the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Firmus AI Cloud&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role Summary&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus\u2019s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus\u2019s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus\u2019s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus\u2019s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company\u2019s AI infrastructure growth.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus&#39;s backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM\/OTN), IP\/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus&#39;s designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers \u2014 keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-parastyle=&quot;No Spacing&quot;&gt;What &lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-parastyle=&quot;No Spacing&quot;&gt;you\u2019ll&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-parastyle=&quot;No Spacing&quot;&gt; bring&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335551550&amp;quot;:6,&amp;quot;335551620&amp;quot;:6,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM\/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification\/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP\/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Skills &amp;amp; Experience&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor&#39;s or Master&#39;s degree in Electrical\/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as a principal-level network architect or distinguished engineer on national and international backbone programmes, and a proven track record owning reference architectures, design standards and technical assurance across a portfolio of concurrent connectivity initiatives.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;This experience should include end-to-end design and delivery across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea cable systems \u2014 including landing-station connectivity, route and duct diversity, and SRLG-based resilience modelling \u2014 alongside deep expertise in optical transport (DWDM\/OTN, coherent optics, 100G\/400G\/800G) and IP backbone design (IP\/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange). They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:120}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets \u2014 particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore \u2014 under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location &amp;amp; Reporting&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;This role is based in Sydney, Australia.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Employment Basis&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Full-time&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Diversity&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;If you\u2019re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you\u2019ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h1&gt;About the Reconciliation team&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world&#39;s largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As part of Ripple, we&#39;re backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h1&gt;What we are looking for&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform.&lt;strong&gt; &lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You&#39;ll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. &lt;\/strong&gt;Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Provide technical leadership and mentorship&lt;\/strong&gt; to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team&#39;s expertise.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Establish infrastructure standards and patterns&lt;\/strong&gt; for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stay hands-on&lt;\/strong&gt;: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions&lt;\/strong&gt; with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;8+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 4+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise with AWS &amp;amp; Kubernetes. Minimum 5+ years experience with each.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About you:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you&#39;re energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led \u2014 we&#39;re looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;hr&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WHO WE ARE:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;Do Your Best Work&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.&amp;nbsp; A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;Bi-weekly all-company meeting - As an IC3, this role is expected to demonstrate strong competency across all key areas of the position, own outcomes end-to-end within their assigned areas, identify and propose process improvements, and collaborate cross-functionally with Central Cash, FA, Intercompany and Leases, AP\/AR, payroll, tax, and external auditors. The role works independently on established processes, escalates early on blockers, and is measured against Coreweave defined HR plan.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Month-End Close &amp;amp; General Ledger&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Own assigned tasks on the month-end close checklist, completing them by their working-day deadlines and escalate any issues as needed. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Review journal entries (cash, accruals, prepaids, reclasses, allocations) prepared by shared service center with complete supporting documentation.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Review balance sheet reconciliations for an assigned portfolio of accounts by WD as assigned, resolving reconciling items so no unexplained differences remain above materiality thresholds.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Understand fixed asset including additions, disposals, and amortization, leases and intercompany prepared by the central team. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Reporting &amp;amp; Analysis&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Review monthly flux\/variance analysis for assigned P&amp;amp;L and balance sheet accounts, explaining all variances above defined thresholds with business drivers.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;Review monthly reporting packages prepared by shared service organisation and prepare a highlights memo for leadership &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;Test assumptions and recommend data-informed solutions when investigating discrepancies or unusual activity. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Review and close the transaction in the secondary ledger. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Controls, Audit &amp;amp; Compliance&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Execute assigned internal controls (SOX or equivalent) accurately and on time, maintaining complete evidence with zero exceptions. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Deliver assigned PBC requests for external audit and internal testing, complete and within agreed turnaround. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;Ensure accounting treatment complies with US GAAP and company policy; flag technical questions to management early. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Process Improvement &amp;amp; Team Support&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Identify inefficiencies in close, reconciliation, and reporting processes and propose or implement improvements (automation, standardization, checklist redesign). &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;Maintain current desktop procedures for all owned processes. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em&gt;&amp;nbsp;Support onboarding of new team members and provide peer review and coverage during high-volume periods, including quarter-end and year-end. &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Qualifications:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;3\u20136+&amp;nbsp; years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of month-end close tasks and balance sheet reconciliations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong working knowledge of US GAAP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;Hands-on experience with a major ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups\/INDEX-MATCH).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&amp;nbsp;Track record of meeting hard close deadlines with high accuracy and complete documentatio&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&amp;nbsp;Track record of setting up new process and controls&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Skills:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;CPA\/ACA\/ACCA\/CIMA or active CPA\/ACA\/ACCA\/CIMA candidate.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Public company or public accounting (audit) experience, including SOX control execution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in high-growth technology, infrastructure, or data center environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exposure to close-management or reconciliation tools (e.g., FloQast) and an interest in automation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why CoreWeave?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!&amp;nbsp; We\u2019re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We\u2019re not afraid of a little chaos, and we\u2019re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be Curious at Your Core&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act Like an Owner&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Empower Employees&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Achieve More Together&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization&#39;s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Center Risk and Assurance, this role ensures that all Data Center Security designs, controls, and operational practices tied to the company\u2019s audit and customer requirements across CoreWeave\u2019s global data center footprint meet defined security standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational expectations. This role will also support new site selection, physical security due diligence, and initial risk evaluation for the EMEA region.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This Program Manager will own the Data Center Security-specific audit framework, oversee comprehensive risk and assurance audits within our operations sites, and partner closely with Security Design, Operations, Legal, and Engineering teams to validate adherence to CoreWeave and its partners\u2019 security objectives. The role requires a strategic thinker with an understanding of physical and operational audit scope, an eye for control assurance, scalability, and strong cross-functional influence in a fast-growing, high-performance environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent CoreWeave\u2019s Data Center Security Operations team, ensuring all DC Security controls and processes align with internal standards, customer contractual requirements, and external regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, etc.).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Audit &amp;amp; Assessments: Plan and lead independent internal audits and control validations across CoreWeave\u2019s data center network; deliver actionable findings and track remediation, ensuring timely treatment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Operational Assurance: Partner with Data Center Operations, Security Design, Security Operations, and Technical Program Management teams to verify that physical security controls are implemented, maintained, and effective.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Site Selection Due Diligence: Conduct physical security due diligence for site selection, ensuring appropriate security requirements are included in Master Service Agreements and other lease contracts, collaborating with Site Selection and Legal teams.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Post Lease or Build Contract Execution: This role informs and collaborates with the Security Design and Security Operations teams to communicate site security requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Metrics and Reporting: Ensure assessments and audit evidence are managed and reported in accordance with CoreWeave controls compliance mechanisms to track control health, audit outcomes, and risk trends.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaboration &amp;amp; Influence: Build strong relationships with internal partners, fostering a culture of accountability and proactive risk management throughout the data center lifecycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Emerging Risk Monitoring: Stay current with evolving threat landscapes, compliance standards, and industry best practices to ensure CoreWeave\u2019s data center security programs remain resilient and forward-looking.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;5+ years of experience in security risk management, compliance, or assurance functions, ideally within cloud, hyperscale, or critical infrastructure environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven success leading risk audits and assurance programs in complex, high-growth organizations.&lt;br&gt;Strong understanding of physical and logical security controls, risk frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, ISO22237, ISO22301, SOC 2, HITrust, FedRAMP), and data center operational security.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated ability to translate technical security concepts into actionable business insights and governance structures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Relevant certifications or on-the-job experience (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor) preferred.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why Us?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We\u2019re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We\u2019re not afraid of a little chaos, and we\u2019re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Be Curious at Your Core&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Act Like an Owner&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Empower Employees&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Achieve More Together&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!&lt;em data-stringify-type=&quot;italic&quot;&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Family-level Medical Insurance&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Family-level Dental Insurance&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Generous Pension Contribution&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Life Assurance at 4x Salary&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Critical Illness Cover&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Employee Assistance Programme&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Tuition Reimbursement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work culture focused on innovative disruption&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Benefits may vary by location.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Equal Opportunity&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Recruitment Agencies&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;em data-stringify-type=&quot;italic&quot;&gt;CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp;amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;em data-stringify-type=&quot;italic&quot;&gt;Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us \u2013 that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy \u2013 will be considered by us to be a \u201cfree gift\u201d, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate\u2019s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate\u2019s details also be submitted by any other party.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Export Control Compliance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This position requires access to export controlled information. &amp;nbsp;To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. \u00a7 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. \u00a7 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. &amp;nbsp;CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (\u201cController\u201d), which is located at&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller\u2019s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller\u2019s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016\/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (\u201cGDPR\u201d) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (\u201cUK GDPR\u201d), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller\u2019s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area (&quot;EEA&quot;) to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;a ----------\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. As well as&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/current-account\/personal&quot;&gt;personal&lt;\/a&gt; and &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/business-banking&quot;&gt;business&lt;\/a&gt; bank accounts, we offer &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/current-account\/joint-account&quot;&gt;joint accounts&lt;\/a&gt;, &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/current-account\/16-17&quot;&gt;accounts for 16-17 year olds&lt;\/a&gt;, a &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/current-account\/under-16s&quot;&gt;free kids account&lt;\/a&gt; and &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/flex&quot;&gt;credit cards&lt;\/a&gt; in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/savings&quot;&gt;save&lt;\/a&gt;, &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/investments&quot;&gt;invest &lt;\/a&gt;and&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/pensions&quot;&gt;combine their pensions&lt;\/a&gt; with us.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo \u2764\ufe0f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;hr&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udccdLondon or Remote (UK) | \ud83d\udcb0\u00a370,000 - \u00a3105,000 +&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/careers#benefits&quot;&gt; Benefits&lt;\/a&gt; |&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;several&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;strong&gt; Senior Product Marketing Managers &lt;\/strong&gt;to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo&#39;s most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We\u2019re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign &amp;amp; channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that\u2019s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;This is a senior individual contributor role.&lt;\/strong&gt; You&#39;ll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available \u2014 we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Where you could join:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Core &lt;\/strong&gt;is the foundation of Monzo. It&#39;s where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people&#39;s daily lives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Borrowing&lt;\/strong&gt; is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo&#39;s Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wealth &lt;\/strong&gt;is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own Product Marketing for a Product. &lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll define a 2\u20134 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You&#39;ll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You&#39;ll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Become the expert on your market. &lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You&#39;ll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Define positioning customers understand. &lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You&#39;ll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Influence Product Strategy.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you&#39;ll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Shape successful launches. &lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You&#39;ll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Measure what matters. &lt;\/strong&gt;You&#39;ll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You&#39;ll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;This is for you if:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You enjoy owning entire products.&lt;\/strong&gt; You&#39;re comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You solve ambiguous problems with evidence.&lt;\/strong&gt; You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You know what makes products win.&lt;\/strong&gt; You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You influence through collaboration.&lt;\/strong&gt; You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;re always improving and helping others improve.&lt;\/strong&gt; You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Interview Process&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our interview process involves three main stages:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Initial Call (30mins)&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Case Study Presentation (45mins)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/blog\/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo&quot;&gt;You can read them here.&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you\u2019ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there\u2019s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What\u2019s in it for you: &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\u00a370,000 - \u00a3105,000 as a base salary&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Learning budget of \u00a31,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;And much more, see our full list of benefits &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/careers#benefits&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;here&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find more <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.fr\/english-speaking-jobs\">English Speaking Jobs in France<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.fr\/jobs\/companies\/doctolib\/senior-ai-data-engineer-paris-paris-394082","tags":["Engineering"],"job_types":[],"location":"Paris, Paris","created_at":1790636104},{"slug":"remote-network-developer-190327","company_name":"Share","title":"Network Developer","description":"<p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Senior Network Developer<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>About Share<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Role<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What you'll do<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI\/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Our Ideal Candidate<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos\/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Nice to have<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Streaming telemetry (gNMI\/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">400G\/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Access networks (GPON\/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">DDoS mitigation at the edge.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)<\/p><p>Find more <a Europe","description":"<p class=\"MsoNormal\"><strong><u>INTITUL\u00c9 :<\/u> \u00ab Qualit\u00e9 des Environnements Int\u00e9rieurs \u00bb.<\/strong><\/p><p
