Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing, you will translate market and customer insights into product features for refinement by engineering teams, while leading the triage, planning and coordination of special customer projects. You will help optimise product lifecycle processes, ensuring efficient collaboration, smooth feature delivery and successful execution from concept through to launch.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own product operations, ensuring features are defined, tracked throughout the product lifecycle and delivered across cross-functional teams.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Translate market and customer insights into product features, while triaging, planning and coordinating special customer projects.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Partner with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing to optimise product lifecycle processes and drive efficient product delivery.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;You will take ownership of the operational delivery of product management, ensuring products and features progress efficiently from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation. Acting as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, you will drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate delivery across multiple teams to ensure products are launched on time and to a high standard. This role is integral to enabling the Product team to scale effectively, providing operational ownership and supporting the successful delivery of an expanding product portfolio.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own the operational delivery of product management, ensuring features progress from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate timely delivery across the product lifecycle.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Act as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, enabling the Product team to scale beyond a single Product Manager.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;In this role, you will take ownership of feature delivery from end to end, defining requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinating engineering handovers, validating delivery and supporting successful commercial launches. You will manage non-standard sales opportunities by assessing feasibility, making configuration decisions within agreed boundaries and documenting exceptions, while ensuring full traceability from customer requests through to delivered capability. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, you will coordinate cross-functional activities to remove blockers, maintain an accurate and prioritised Jira backlog, and respond to product enquiries from Sales. You will also prepare products for launch through documentation, training, pricing and sales enablement, maintain up-to-date product documentation, communicate complex photonic, cryogenic and networking architectures to a range of stakeholders, and represent the product in customer-facing activities including pre-sales support, technical discussions and trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own end-to-end feature delivery, from requirements definition and engineering handover through to delivery validation, commercial launch and ongoing product documentation.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Coordinate cross-functionally with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, while managing Jira backlog integrity, product enquiries and non-standard sales opportunities.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Support successful product adoption by communicating complex technical architectures, ensuring launch readiness, providing pre-sales support and representing the product in customer discussions and at trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;The ideal candidate will hold a Master&#39;s degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, combined with an action-oriented mindset and the confidence to make decisions in an environment of uncertainty. You will be able to understand and reason about complex hardware products involving photonics, cryogenics and networking technologies, while communicating effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders. You will be comfortable representing products in customer-facing situations, including technical discussions, pre-sales meetings and trade shows, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing environments, including industrialisation constraints, production realities and supply chain considerations. You will also be confident resolving conflicting priorities, negotiating with stakeholders and developing deep expertise in quantum technologies, supported by advanced Jira proficiency, including workflow configuration, automation rules and custom field management.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Master&#39;s degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, with the ability to make product decisions autonomously within defined boundaries.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Strong technical, commercial and customer-facing communication skills, with experience discussing complex hardware products and representing products in pre-sales meetings and trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Advanced Jira expertise, manufacturing and industrialisation knowledge, excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, and a genuine curiosity for deep-tech and quantum technologies.&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1892&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES\/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2\/SHA-3, HMAC\/KDF constructions), RSA\/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A\/B\/C). You will define the hybrid classical\/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA\/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical\/PQC hybrid schemes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical\/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical knowledge of hybrid classical\/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;We are committed to equity and justice. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world\u2019s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ\u2019s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;amp;index=8&amp;amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Amazon Web Services, &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=and&amp;amp;index=9&amp;amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;and &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;amp;index=10&amp;amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;AstraZeneca&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1891&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS: hardware\/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203\/204\/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make\/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security\/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the programme\u2019s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build\/buy\/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203\/204\/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;What We Offer:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. At Acadia, we\u2019re here to be their difference.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Position Summary&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs Europe is responsible for the implementation and execution of global regulatory development, submission and lifecycle maintenance strategies for assigned products in Europe. Further, the Associate Director will assist in building a European regulatory infrastructure that is fit for purpose in line with Acadia\u2019s product pipeline, patient and caregiver needs and in full compliance with European regulatory requirements and standards.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Primary Variations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Plan and coordinate heath authority meetings including the preparation and authoring of major components of briefing documentation in close collaboration with cross-functional teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop regulatory strategy for assigned products in line with the global regulatory strategy ensuring competitive labeling and approval timelines in Europe (through centralised, decentralised or national procedures).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the European Regulatory Subteam during major submissions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor, evaluate, and interpret applicable regulatory requirements to assure compliance with external and internal standards.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support early access\/ compassionate use programs in Europe.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Execute team, group, or project objectives to ensure they align with Regulatory strategy and corporate goals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain appropriate communication within the Regulatory Affairs function and other cross-functional departments primarily at the project team level.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participates in professional associations, industry, and trade Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson\u2019s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer\u2019s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we\u2019re here to be their difference.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;Position Summary:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Responsible for oversight of commercial Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMO\u2019s), and other third-party suppliers for products as identified, including the transfer of processes from R&amp;amp;D\/Product development to commercial third-party suppliers. Responsible for oversight of ongoing manufacturing schedules to ensure both development and commercial supply levels are maintained, and inventory targets are met. Ensures that manufacturing activities meet the needs of all internal and external constituencies with an emphasis on process, quality, budget control and profitability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Primary Responsibilities:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develops and maintains good working relationships with contract manufacturers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Negotiate and manage CMO contracts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develops SOP\u2019s and work processes needed for Commercial Manufacturing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Works with CMOs to diagnose and correct process issues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identifies, evaluates and selects CMOs for the manufacture of Commercial products&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develops, collects appropriate metrics to measure CMO performance; leads CMO partnership teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Works with Quality Group to determine the impact of process deviations and works towards resolutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develops timelines, goals, and deliverables for API and related manufacturing processes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optimizes the manufacturing process to maintain high product quality, improve process portability, increase process robustness, improve process efficiency, and reduce manufacturing costs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assists in developing drug substance sourcing strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;With Quality Assurance, ensures CMOs remain current and compliant with all GMP related requirements, guidelines and procedures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Tracks deviations and processes changes for the different suppliers and collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance in assessing their impact on regulatory filings.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Initiates and coordinates the preparation of CMC documentation as required&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborates with Regulatory Affairs and other groups to support product filings.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assists in contract site preparation activities for regulatory inspections.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Supports interdisciplinary working teams with recommendations, advice and action plans for manufacturing related issues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide onsite process coverage as person-in-plant as needed&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicates manufacturing or technology related issues and information to committees, teams and interested groups within the company.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Supervise, train and mentor personnel as needed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Education\/Experience\/Skills:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;BS in Engineering\/Chemistry or equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience. Master&#39;s or Ph.D. preferred.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp; A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience within the pharmaceutical\/biotechnology industry with 6 years in a leadership role.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Must possess:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contract service provider experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Understanding is required of the biopharmaceutical drug development process including regulatory filings and quality inspections and audits.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive knowledge of regulations as they pertain to post-approval manufacturing process changes; site changes, etc.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Frequent travel to global manufacturing sites in the EU and Asia is required for this role&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Scope:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Participate in strategic plans for designated function(s) and may participate with senior management to align objectives across the organization. Develops methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and people. Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth knowledge of functional area and related organizational objectives. Erroneous decisions will have a serious impact on the overall success of functional area and may impact on the long-term success of the company.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Physical Requirements:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, see, talk or hear in a standard office environment and independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and\/or move up to 20 pounds. Ability to travel by car or airplane independently up to 50% of the time both domestically, internationally, and work after hours if required by travel schedule or business issues.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;What we offer US-based Employees:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt; &lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive base, bonus, new hire and ongoing equity packages&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Medical, dental, and vision insurance&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Employer-paid life, disability, business travel and EAP coverage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;401(k) Plan with a fully vested company match 1:1 up to 5%&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 2-year purchase price lock-in&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;15+ vacation days&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;13 -15 paid holidays, including office closure between December 24th and January 1st&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;10 days of paid sick time&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Paid parental leave benefit&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Tuition assistance&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;EEO Statement (US-based Employees): &lt;\/strong&gt;Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every one of the qualifications in the exact way they are described in job postings. That candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background or may meet the qualifications in a different way. We&#39;re a tight-knit team of security incident responders and incident handlers doing &quot;Security for Databricks on Databricks&quot;, using our own platform to create near-real-time log analytics, alerting and forensics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be an individual contributor on the security Incident Response (IR) team at Databricks, reporting to the regional IR manager. You will be responsible for conducting security analysis and forensics, responding to high-priority alerts and contributing to automations and agentic capabilities. You will be a security multiplier and help the team scale security incident response at Databricks.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The impact you will have:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will respond to incidents as part of a distributed 24x7 operations and on-call schedule.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will triage and respond to security events and alerts, ensuring quick and effective containment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will conduct analysis and forensics across a range of data sources to determine the timeline and impact of security events.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will provide technical leadership and influence team direction.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will develop solutions, including leveraging AI and agentic platforms, to deliver autonomous capabilities, expedite your work and scale the impact of the team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will communicate technical decisions through design docs and tech talks, and mentor junior security responders via security guidance, design reviews and code reviews.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we look for:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s Degree AND 7+ years experience in Incident Response work OR Master&#39;s Degree AND 5+ years experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cloud security expertise in at least 1 of AWS, GCP or Azure, and proficiency in the others.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in AI\/LLM and agentic capabilities. Prefer experience with building and operating agentic systems in a security setting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Broad security subject matter expertise.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Expertise in a few core IR skills (DFIR , Reverse Engineering, Traditional Network Security, Storage and access security, Sandboxing, Compute security, etc.).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with Enterprise Security and SaaS applications.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of a SIEM and SOAR.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building Incident Response Tooling, scripting language skills and experience with AI coding tools.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Databricks&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide \u2014 including adidas, AT&amp;amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 \u2014 rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/company\/databricks&quot;&gt;LinkedIn&lt;\/a&gt;, &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/x.com\/databricks&quot;&gt;X&lt;\/a&gt;, &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/@Databricks&quot;&gt;YouTube&lt;\/a&gt;, and &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.instagram.com\/databricksinc\/?hl=en&quot;&gt;Instagram&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Benefits&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/docs.google.com\/document\/d\/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ\/edit?usp=sharing&quot;&gt;here&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compliance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer&#39;s discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\">Jobs in Switzerland<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\/jobs\/companies\/databricks\/staff-security-engineer-incident-response-168072","tags":["Security"],"job_types":[],"location":"","created_at":1790564115},{"slug":"sr-forward-deployed-engineer-fde-fullstack-zurich-124736","company_name":"databricks","title":"Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer - FDE (Fullstack)","description":"&lt;p&gt;CSQ427R397&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Sr Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data &amp;amp; AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. We believe there&#39;s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h4&gt;The Role&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;To push further our vision of Enterprise AI, we are looking for a senior leader to grow and lead our team of Enterprise Architects.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This high-impact leadership role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise, people management experience, and executive presence. You will act as an executive sponsor, confidently presenting to customer C-level executives and helping your team translate strategic goals into actionable technical plans.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your primary goal is to lead and empower a team that supports our growing sales organization in achieving revenue goals. You will ensure your team successfully unlocks technical blockers by fostering close partnerships with leadership across Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Measures of Success&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your success will be measured by your team&#39;s impact, including new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and your overarching contribution to the overall sales team and business success.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;The work you\u2019ll do:&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Team Leadership: Hire, mentor, and manage a team of Enterprise Architects who define the overall architecture, data, and cloud strategy for our largest client accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Executive Engagement: Act as an executive sponsor in pre-Sales and post-Sales phases, presenting strategic visions to C-level executives and engaging with customer Architecture and security teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive Strategic Innovation: Guide your team to design architectures that drive enterprise modernization, leverage capability mapping, and explore innovative solutions using emergent technologies like Agentic AI.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the leadership bridge between our product &amp;amp; engineering teams within Celonis and client teams to ensure the delivery of premier technical services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ecosystem &amp;amp; Readiness: Oversee the assessment of the IT landscape maturity of our customer installed base and ensure your team effectively coaches Celonis account teams and ecosystem partners on architecture, integration, performance, and scalability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Thought Leadership: Direct the development of re-usable assets for projects, as well as customer-facing position papers and thought leadership presentations on architecture and innovation with Celonis.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;The qualifications you need:&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience: 20+ years of relevant experience, including a proven track record of managing Enterprise Architects or technical teams at a top consulting firm or software vendor.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strategic Vision: Proven ability to think strategically, guiding your team to connect technical solutions to business value and customer objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of navigating complex negotiations and presenting to C-level executives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Enterprise Architecture Expertise: Demonstrated experience and deep understanding of Capability Mapping, Enterprise Modernization, and Agentic AI.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technical Foundation: Strong background in Data Architecture, system integrations, data operations, automation capabilities, and data-related languages (SQL, Python, etc.). You must be able to comfortably switch from discussing high-level architecture strategy to understanding hands-on demo environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ecosystem Knowledge: Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS solutions (Salesforce, SAP, Dynamics CRM, ServiceNow), cybersecurity posture fundamentals, API ecosystems, and legacy on-premise enterprise architectures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Education: MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent in an Information Technology-related field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Languages: Fluency in English is required; an additional language such as Spanish, French, German, or Italian is a strong advantage.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Preferred:&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Celonis Certifications and extensive leadership experience managing projects with OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Industry standard certifications such as AWS\/Azure\/GCP, ESB \/ ETL (Mulesoft, Oracle, SAP, Talend, Informatica), or TOGAF\/Zachmann.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience spanning at least two domains (e.g., Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, HR) and at least two industries (e.g., Consumer Goods, Banking, Pharma, Aerospace).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 255, 255);&quot; Speechify\u2019s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.&amp;nbsp;Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting \u2013 Speechify has no office.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Overview&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;text-align: left;&quot; data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API,&amp;nbsp;payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics \u2014 serving over 50&amp;nbsp;million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;text-align: left;&quot; data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent&amp;nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&amp;nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&amp;nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&amp;nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully \u2014 it is either right, or&amp;nbsp;someone gets charged twice.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of&amp;nbsp;you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one.&amp;nbsp;That is the entire growth path on this team \u2014 there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling&amp;nbsp;except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&amp;nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Yo&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;u\u2019&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&amp;nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Take on services you didn&#39;t write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&amp;nbsp;correct after you&#39;ve moved on&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Automate the parts of your role that shouldn&#39;t need a person, then go take on what that&amp;nbsp;freed you up for&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Turn work you&#39;ve done once into work the whole team can repeat&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li data-speechify-sentence=&quot;&quot;&gt;Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&amp;nbsp;product is going&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An Ideal Candidate Should Have&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven backend experience in TS\/Node (required)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&amp;nbsp;created&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail \u2014 what runs unattended,&amp;nbsp;what you review, and where you&#39;ve decided it doesn&#39;t get to act alone&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The instinct to check a result against the system itself \u2014 logs, database state, the actual&amp;nbsp;request \u2014 rather than against a summary of it&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A preference for being corrected over being right&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Interview process&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&amp;nbsp;finish within a week.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The assessment runs in two stages: you&#39;ll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&amp;nbsp;team, and have time to act on it.
